name: What is the average cost range for a room addition in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost range for a room addition in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a room addition in Orange County can vary significantly based on factors such as square footage, materials chosen, complexity of the design, and finishes. A rough estimate might range from $200 to $500 per square foot or more. This figure can include architectural plans, permits, foundation work, framing, roofing, electrical, plumbing, insulation, drywall, and finishes. A detailed estimate requires an assessment of your specific project scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Room addition costs in Orange County typically range from $200-$500+ per square foot, depending on size, materials, and complexity.
